title: Saved posters and clearer History
summary: Keep posters after deleting media from Jellyfin, recover missing artwork, and separate stopped viewings.
highlights: Jellydash keeps small copies of Jellyfin's selected posters, including custom artwork, for History, Statistics and Monthly recap. A poster must be saved successfully before its source is deleted.

Online poster recovery is on by default. Verified TMDB IDs can recover automatically; saved titles produce suggestions for you to confirm under Settings > Saved posters. Older History may need Check existing History first.
Stopping and restarting an unfinished item creates a separate viewing when Jellydash observes the stop. Pausing and resuming stays together. Stops entirely between checks may still share a row.

History shows recorded time separately from playback position. A full position bar does not mean the entire runtime was recorded. Existing viewing time stays intact; an ongoing play may split once during this upgrade.
